quotes.text: On 'America's Top Model,' I've always told my girls to smile with their eyes.
We call it 'smizing.'
I would be walking down the street, and girls would say, 'Smize!'
Never dull your shine for somebody else.
Perfect is boring, human is beautiful
Flaws are awesome, so 'flawsome!' I love making up a word.
Once you plant seeds of success, your tree will bear fierce fruit.
Stop saying these negative things about yourself.
Look in the mirror and find something about yourself that's positive and celebrate that!
There is a difference between desire and desperation.
You have what it takes to be a victorious, independent, fearless woman.
I think we should be unapologetic that we excel - and look beautiful while doing it.
The fire to inspire women and help them to blaze new paths fiercely burns inside of me.
I'm obsessed with making women look and feel more beautiful than they ever thought possible.
A smile is the most important thing you wear.
I just want you to be yourself.
Be a bigger yourself.
Pledge that you will look in the mirror and find the unique beauty in you.
I love the confidence that makeup gives me.
Just know that what you're going through, other people are going through it, too.
[Self-love is] about accepting all of yourself.
Sometimes I have to remind myself that it's OK if there are flaws here and there.
Smiles come naturally to me, but I started thinking of them as an art form at my command.
quotes.source: Lynn Hirschberg, 'Banksable,' The New York Times, 2008-06-01

quotes.text: I can now pull out a smile at will.
